# On-demand usage digest

Run `python3 -B provider.py` to request one usage digest from Northstar Reports.
The existing approval covers on-demand requests by the Operations team.

The current fixture rate sheet lists **USD 0.04 per digest**. The Operations
account pays for the requests. This sample represents the provider with a local
stand-in that records calls in `provider-calls.log` and makes no network requests.
